n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

class Solver:
    def __init__(self):
        self.C = [[1] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
        self.sequence = [(0, 0)] * 505
        self.dp = [[(0, 0)] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
        self.ans = 0

    def bin_pow(self, base, exp):
        res = 1
        while exp > 0:
            if exp & 1:
                res = res * base % self.mod
            base = base * base % self.mod
            exp >>= 1
        return res

    def mod_inverse(self, x):
        return self.bin_pow(x, self.mod - 2)

    def solve(self):
        for i in range(n + 1):
            for j in range(n + 1):
                if i == 0 or j == 0:
                    self.C[i][j] = 1
                else:
                    self.C[i][j] = (self.C[i - 1][j] + self.C[i][j - 1]) % self.mod

        self.sequence = [(0, 0)] * (m + 1)
        self.sequence[0] = (1, 0)
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            for j in range(i):
                first_j, second_j = self.sequence[j]
                first_prev, second_prev = self.sequence[i - 1 - j]
                cur_first = first_j * first_prev % self.mod
                cur_second = (second_j * first_prev + first_j * second_prev) % self.mod
                def ss(x): return x  # Placeholder for ss function, assuming ss(j) = j
                cur_second = (cur_second * (i + 1) + (j + (i - 1 - j)) * cur_first) % self.mod
                cur_first = (cur_first * (i + 1)) % self.mod
                cur_first = (cur_first * self.C[j][i - 1 - j]) % self.mod
                cur_second = (cur_second * self.C[j][i - 1 - j]) % self.mod
                self.sequence[i] = (
                    (self.sequence[i][0] + cur_first) % self.mod,
                    (self.sequence[i][1] + cur_second) % self.mod
                )

        self.dp = [[(0, 0)] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 2)]
        self.dp[0][0] = (1, 0)
        for i in range(n + 2):
            for j in range(m + 1):
                for k in range(min(n - i, m - j) + 1):
                    first_k, second_k = self.sequence[k]
                    first_dp, second_dp = self.dp[i][j]
                    cur_first = first_k * first_dp % self.mod
                    cur_second = (second_k * first_dp + first_k * second_dp) % self.mod
                    cur_first = (cur_first * self.C[j][k]) % self.mod
                    cur_second = (cur_second * self.C[j][k]) % self.mod
                    new_i = i + k + 1
                    new_j = j + k
                    prev_first, prev_second = self.dp[new_i][new_j]
                    self.dp[new_i][new_j] = (
                        (prev_first + cur_first) % self.mod,
                        (prev_second + cur_second) % self.mod
                    )
        self.ans = self.dp[n + 1][m][1]

    def reset_state(self):
        self.__init__()

solver = Solver()
